Title: Azure Functions portal and host improvements

Body.Content:
Based on great customer feedback, we’ve redesigned the Azure Functions portal experience. Now you can see more of your code and see your logs and the Run window at the same time. The Run window has new features for HTTP-triggered functions: you can specify the HTTP verb and add query parameters and request headers. This makes it easy to test these functions without leaving the Functions portal.

Aside from the visual improvements, we’ve released a lot of new functionality in the Azure Functions 0.7 host and 0.8 host, including support for custom routes and route templates.

Read more about the improvements in the team blog.
